title: PUPSEED - Grow Joy
credits: The toy is equipped with a water tank that allows watering the seeds during the planting process promoting healthy plant growth.
description: Introducing PupSeed, the ultimate gardening toy for children! This innovative and interactive toy allows kids to cultivate their own garden while having fun. With remote control functionality, a water tank for plant hydration, a seed compartment for easy planting, an excavator function for soil preparation, and advanced sensors for optimal growth conditions, PupSeed brings the joy of gardening to young green thumbs. The expressive eye display adds an extra touch of excitement, conveying emotions and indicating the need for water or more seeds. Let your child explore the wonders of nature and nurture their love for plants with PupSeed!
The toy is equipped with a water tank that allows watering the seeds during the planting process, promoting healthy plant growth.
The toy has a special compartment for loading seeds, making the planting process easier and ensuring proper distribution of seeds in the soil.

Excavator function: A part of the toy is designed as an excavator, allowing children to smooth and prepare the soil before planting the seeds. This helps create an optimal environment for plant growth.

Detection sensor: The toy features a sensor that detects soil moisture and quality. This enables the toy to automatically adjust the amount of water and planting depth, ensuring optimal conditions for seed growth.

Proximity sensor: The toy is also equipped with a proximity sensor that detects obstacles and avoids collisions during operation. This ensures safety during use and prevents damage to both the toy and surrounding objects.

Expressive eye display: The toy includes a screen with an expressive eye that can display various emotions. This feature allows the toy to playfully and creatively communicate the need for water or the availability of seeds. For example, the eye may show a happy expression when the plants have enough water and seeds, or a sad expression when they need attention.
